title: Settings
clear_body: The data downloads again when you open a screen. Your language and theme stay.
system_note: Text size and motion follow the system settings.
alerts_hint: A message when new data is available.
alerts_denied_body: Allow notifications for PICO in the system settings so the messages can arrive.
alerts_sheet_body: PICO sends a message when new data is available, a few times a month at most. No ads.
alerts_sheet_device: To send it, PICO uses the OneSignal service. After you allow it, OneSignal receives your device ID. You can turn it off here at any time.
